form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.notes: Born-digital typed form (v. 4.20). The zeros in Boxes A, B, D, F and Balance at Close are actually TYPED '0' characters (not blanks), so they are genuine zeros; only Boxes C and E carry a figure (5388.90 each), i.e. this final report adds nothing to the year-to-date. NEITHER amendment radio (No / Yes) is filled, so is_amendment is blank. Office is printed simply 'Surveyor' (index.csv carries 'County Surveyor' - a naming convention, not a conflict). The signature block is redacted upstream by the county (black bar); address, phone and email survive. This form prints no political-party field. Clerk stamp 'RECEIVED DEC 03 REC'D'. The Page boxes are blank on both pages.
